description: `hermes chat -Q --query=PROMPT` runs one non-interactive turn; -Q keeps stdout to the answer (plus tool previews, which end in \r\n), and the session id goes to stderr. `--source tool` keeps callai runs out of the user's session list. Not `hermes -z`: it auto-approves every tool call, so it can only honour bypass. Verified against hermes-agent 0.19.0.
